name: 🐍 Snake Game
desc:
Can you become the Biggest SNAKE? Eat Color blocks to Upgrade your stats and Dominate your Server

🐍 HOW TO PLAY 🐍
🏃  Move around to eat blocks
⭐ Level up & upgrade your stats
😋 Eat Others to earn Cash and grow bigger
🐍 Unlock New Snakes & Evolve Them to become the BEST!

⭐ Make sure to give feedback on how to improve the game!
